title: Shane Steichen says Colts have not shut down Alec Pierce for the season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Shane Steichen says Colts have not shut down Alec Pierce for the season
sources.description: A report from NFL Media on Sunday morning indicated that the Colts have decided to pull the plug on hopes that wide receiver Alec Pierce will return to action this season, but it appears to have been premature.
